documented_meaning: Size of the PDF file in kilobytes.
measurement_method: exact byte size plus unassigned KiB candidate
notes: Historical KB conversion is undocumented; canonical value is null.

documented_meaning: Size of metadata extracted from the PDF file, in bytes.
notes: Historical extracted-metadata byte representation is undocumented.

documented_meaning: Number of pages in the PDF file.
special_value_handling: 0 is documented as occurring in deliberately corrupted malicious PDFs.
notes: Parser differences and malformed-file behavior cannot be compared with original extractor.

documented_meaning: xref length as extracted from the file header.
notes: Paper does not define the header-derived xref-length algorithm.

documented_meaning: Number of characters in the file title.
notes: Metadata decoding/normalization may differ from the original extractor.

documented_meaning: 1 if the file is encrypted; 0 otherwise.
notes: Passwords are never requested or attempted.

documented_meaning: Number of embedded files inside the PDF, as extracted from the header.
measurement_method: bounded parser traversal of /EF file-specification dictionaries
notes: May differ from the paper's header-extraction method.

documented_meaning: Number of images in the PDF file.
special_value_handling: -1 means the file is corrupted and the number of images cannot be shown.
notes: No rendering/export; parser handling may differ from PDFMalExtract.

documented_meaning: Whether the file contains at least the default threshold of 50 text characters.
measurement_method: pypdf text length threshold of 50 characters
special_value_handling: 1: threshold met; 0: threshold not met; -1: corrupted file and text could not be read.
notes: Failures remain null, never mapped to RIT -1 without equivalence evidence.

documented_meaning: PDF version extracted from the file header.
special_value_handling: The paper documents max 5 although the highest valid PDF version is 2.0; it attributes such invalid values to many malicious samples. Meaning of 0 is not explained.
notes: Unusual headers are retained; value 0 semantics remain unverified.
